title: Let's Fix a Kitty!
description:
This is Stitch, who was rescued and brought to Vet Ranch for a rear leg amputation due to a nonfunctional foot.  I decided to try something different. ;)

Vet Ranch Shirts!!! http://www.magpul.com/vetranch

If you are interested in helping with animals in the future, please visit http://www.vetranchrescue.org to learn more about what we do and to donate if you would like.  The only thing holding us back at the moment is lack of funds.  There is no shortage of pets in need, so every donation means more lives we can positively change.  If you are not able to donate, please enjoy the videos and share if you like them!!!

For pictures and behind the scenes info on current animals we are working on, be sure to follow us at https://www.facebook.com/VetRanch

The music in the video is called "Rosa Dear" by the band "Ruth".  Ruth has given Vet Ranch direct permission to use their music on this channel.
author: Vet Ranch
